messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — I pushed cicada-3b-v2 into the staging registry and want to lock a lightweight canary in the catalog tomorrow morning. Who can own the deploy and smoke?
Samir Patel: I can take the deploy window 09:30 PT. planning 10m canary at 5% then step to 25% if smoke passes.
Mia Chen: thanks @Samir. can you also run the quick prompt-set (attached below) for quality checks?
Samir Patel: yup. drop the prompt set name and I'll run it under `eng-ml/smoke/cicada-v2/quick.yaml`
Mia Chen: prompt set: `cicada-lite-ops-checks-v1` — includes 12 prompts (few-shot + edge cases).
Leo Nguyen: I'll handle rollback readiness and the ops playbook. If the KV cache fails on 2x longer tail latency we rollback the alias.
Nina Roberts: FYI, I've staged a pinned alias `cicada:stable` -> `cicada-3b-v1` so we can swap fast. also added a canary feature flag `catalog.canary.cicada.v2` in flight.
Samir Patel: deploy script I'll call: `./deploy_catalog --model cicada-3b-v2 --mode canary --percent 5 --owner samir`
Samir Patel: smoke checklist (quick):
```
# quick smoke
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"model":"cicada-3b-v2","input":"Summarize: \"X\"","max_tokens":60}' | jq .choices[0].text
run ci/smoke/latency-check --threshold 150ms
run ci/smoke/kvcache-check --min-hit-rate 0.6
```
Mia Chen: @deploy-bot can you reserve slot `slot-ops-17` for 09:20-10:00 PT and annotate the run?
deploy-bot: Slot reserved: slot-ops-17 for 2024-08-12T09:20:00-07:00 to 2024-08-12T10:00:00-07:00. Tag: cicada-v2-canary. :white_check_mark:
Nina Roberts: small perf note: if memory pressure climbs above 78% switch canary to half throughput (rate-limit) before rollback. adds some buffer.
Leo Nguyen: rollback command ready: `./catalog_swap_alias --alias cicada:stable --target cicada-3b-v1 --reason "canary regressions"` — I tested in staging.
Samir Patel: plan: 09:20 reserve slot + prechecks, 09:30 deploy 5%, run quick smoke (12 prompts + 3 latency runs), 09:45 step to 25% if no errors, 09:55 finalize pin and update catalog metadata.
Mia Chen: perfect. I'll watch the eval dashboard and ping infra if any kernel OOMs show. Posting the quick-check checklist in the thread. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
Nina Roberts: I'll keep an eye on billing/cost signals during the canary, will mute alerts except P99 CPU/GPU spikes.
Samir Patel: leaving notes in the run log: `owner: samir`, `rollback: leo`, `precheck-by: mia`, `smoke-set: cicada-lite-ops-checks-v1`.
Mia Chen: if anything blocks, reply here. otherwise go-ahead tomorrow.
Leo Nguyen: ack.
Nina Roberts: ack.
Samir Patel: ack, see you tomorrow 09:20 PT.
